column1: # gc_sites.tsv - gin-control, the preparation stage: every call of gdakiTsSend, gdakiTsPump, gdakiTsRecv, gdakiRsRecvOn,
# gdakiTsAnswerFail, gdakiHoldSend and every use of a peer's helper socket fd in gin-mirror ln4's host file (md5 0ab4e636;
# line numbers are ln4's), the record path's reads of the peer state, with its class and what the preparation stage did
# (impl/rs_ctrl_api.h). class: record (the rdma build carries it on the ring), rejoin (UD), data (outbox, store),
# witness (stays TCP in both builds), backend (the TCP back end itself). kind: send, pump, recv, answer, holdsend, fd
# (pe.fd), fd-other (another spelling of a peer's .fd), accept (what a witness accept also takes), state (pe.gone, pe.gen,
# pe.have and the like on the record path: phase 2's list). action: swapped (gdakiCtrlSend, gdakiCtrlPump, gdakiCtrlRecv,
# gdakiCtrlRecvOn, gdakiCtrlRejoinFail), via-12987 (through gdakiHoldSend's swapped send), chanup (gdakiCtrlChanUp, the
# rdma side of an #if NCCL_GIN_CTRL_TCP / #else whose tcp side is ln4's line), pollfd (gdakiCtrlPollFd), install
# (gdakiCtrlChanInstall), changen (gdakiCtrlChanGen, as chanup), arg (the .fd stays: gdakiCtrlSend's TCP back end argument),
# kept (ln4's text). build_gc.sh sites checks the rows against ln4 and the counts against the tree's rdma side.
